Snapshot a volumetric slice

Source: R/snapshots.R
snapshot_slice.Rd

Creates a PNG image of a single slice from a volumetric label file. Supports MGZ and NIfTI formats.

Usage

snapshot_slice(
  lab,
  x,
  y,
  z,
  view,
  label_file = NULL,
  output_dir,
  skip_existing = get_skip_existing(),
  width = 400,
  height = 400
)

Arguments

lab

Path to volume file (.mgz, .nii, .nii.gz) or .label file. If a .label file is provided, label_file must also be provided.

x, y, z

Slice coordinates

view

View type: "axial", "sagittal", or "coronal"

label_file

Path to volume file (required when lab is a .label file)

output_dir

Output directory for PNG

skip_existing

Skip if output file exists

width, height

Image dimensions in pixels

Value

Invisible NULL
